description: Traffic Links Stats is a dataset listed in ACT Government open data portal (www.data.act.gov.au), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by ACT Government. This dataset contains historic Link Definitions and Performance Statistics with Geometry of traffic flow. The detailed documentation is included at Disclaimer: Even though the real-time API updates the info every 30 seconds, we only sample at every 5 minutes for historical archiving. Coverage: Australian Capital Territory. The portal files it under the category Transport. Its tags are traffic flow. The table has 20 columns. Attribution on the portal: Roads ACT. The portal shows 2023-12-20 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-act-gov-au-portal.
